# Indonesian <-> English translation benchmark

Agent-oriented map of this project. Live results: https://translation-comparison-en-id.bevry.workers.dev
Repo: https://github.com/bevry-vibes/translation-comparison-en-id

## What this is

A benchmark harness comparing translation models (open-weight LLMs via hosted gateways,
dedicated NMT, local Ollama models, hosted translators) for Indonesian<->English, scored with
sacrebleu chrF/chrF++/BLEU plus a strict masked-name token-survival protocol. It exists to pick
and supervise the production translator of a website, and currently recommends
`qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507` on OpenRouter with the `engine-preserve` instruction.

## Where to look

- Interpreting or comparing results: results/README.md in the repo (read this first — comparability rules, replication commands)
- Live tables, per-category chrF, masked-name survival: the site (sections: Quality / Token survival toggle, Category chrF, Current recommendation, Prompts & replication)
- The model survey and decision history: docs/model-survey.md
- Indonesian linguistic pipeline checklist: docs/indonesian-notes.md
- Harness: eval/run_eval.py (CLI), eval/backends.py (providers + verbatim prompt templates), eval/token_survival.py (survival scoring), eval/build_site_data.py (site data builder)
- Sweeps: scripts/run-providers.sh (OpenRouter + DeepSeek), scripts/run-cloud.sh (QwenCloud + Cloudflare + Kagi)
